program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const u = inputs.launchSpeed; const g = inputs.gravity; const m = inputs.mass; const t = time; const velocity = u - g * t; const height = u * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; const acceleration = -g; const force = m * g; const apexTime = u / g; const apexHeight = (u * u) / (2 * g); let motionState = "Rising"; if (t < 0.001) motionState = "Ready to toss"; else if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) motionState = "At the top"; else if (velocity < 0 && height > 0) motionState = "Falling"; else if (height <= 0 && t > 0.1) motionState = "Back at launch height"; else if (height <= 0) motionState = "Ready to toss"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 35, w: 290, h: 360, title: "Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 60, y: 365, length: 280, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballY = 365 - (height / 2.2) * 280; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 150, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 175, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 215, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(235, ballY - 25, [`v: ${velocity.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${acceleration.toFixed(2)} m/s^2`, `Fg: ${force.toFixed(1)} N`], { id: "callout.toss" })); const pts = []; const stepCount = 20; for (let i = 0; i <= stepCount; i++) { const ti = (i / stepCount) * 1.6666666666666667; const vi = u - g * ti; const xi = (ti / 1.6666666666666667) * 260; const yi = 365 - ((vi + 5.5) / 11) * 260; pts.push([xi, yi]); } objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 330, y: 35, w: 290, h: 360, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.67, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: sdk.sample((ti) => u - g * ti, 0, Math.min(t, 1.6666666666666667), 20).map(([ti, vi]) => [(ti / 1.6666666666666667) * 290, 395 - ((vi + 5.5) / 11.0) * 320]) }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 340, 390, "Slope a = -g", { role: "neutral" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: u, gravity: g, mass: m, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, v = 0, but the acceleration stays -g and force is mg. Mass changes force, not motion.
manifest.description: A ball is tossed vertically, showing velocity, acceleration arrows, and a velocity-time graph side by side.
